results.reading: Per lane over the 18 eligible documents: SocratiCode and ai-memory each recover 11/12 intended sources in the top 3 and both miss 'selected text provider savings' in the top 5. The recorded QMD baseline (8/12) returned results only from the same 18 eligible documents, but its BM25 document-frequency and length statistics covered 33 documents (blueprints/us-equities/retrieval-evaluation/README.md and full-corpus-manifest.json: the collection filter is applied after scoring). The returnable set is therefore identical; the lexical scoring statistics differ, so the per-lane numbers are comparable on result set but not identical in scoring corpus. The QMD figures cannot be attributed to either lane. (Correction 2026-09-23 round 3, source review: earlier text called the 15 extra documents distractors in the ranking.)
